readout_other: Fos immunohistochemistry; freezing behavior scoring; real-time place preference (chamber avoidance); operant lever-pressing during cocaine self-administration, extinction, and retention testing; locomotor velocity
direction_notes: tFUS of the elPBN increased Fos expression (neuronal activation), consistent with excitation of this aversion-signaling region; behaviorally this activation produced freezing, place avoidance, and a persistent suppression of cocaine-reinforced lever pressing.
safety_notes: Temperature beneath the skull rose by less than 0.5 degrees C during a single 4.5-s or 9-s stimulation and by about 0.5 degrees C after 20 consecutive stimulations, levels the authors describe as unlikely to affect behavior; an off-target control receiving identical acoustic exposure showed no behavioral suppression, arguing against a nonspecific thermal effect.

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed 5 MHz sine waves (PD 0.5 ms, PRF 1 kHz) were gated into 0.5-s bursts (BD) separated by 1-s inter-burst intervals (IBI). For the c-Fos assay and open-arena behavioral test, six or four such 9-s trains were delivered with 60-s inter-sonication intervals. For the RTPP test, bursts were delivered continuously for up to 1 min while the animal occupied the paired chamber, followed by a 30-s timeout. During cocaine self-administration extinction, each active lever press triggered a 4.5-s train (3 bursts) over a 4-day extinction phase.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The same animals used in the preceding freezing and placeavoidance experiments were subsequently tested in the cocaine operant paradigm (tFUS, n = 10, 5 males/5 females; pooled control, n = 10, 6 males/4 females, comprising sham and off-target controls, n = 5 each).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: To induce neuromodulatory effects, bilateral tFUS stimulation was delivered at the resonant frequency of the device (5 MHz) to generate low-intensity ultrasound, as described previously [28].
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: Pulsed sine waves with a pulse duration (PD) of 0.5 ms were repeated at a pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 1 kHz and gated within square waves to form ultrasound bursts (Fig. 1C).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: Pulsed sine waves with a pulse duration (PD) of 0.5 ms were repeated at a pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 1 kHz and gated within square waves to form ultrasound bursts (Fig. 1C).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The stimulation parameters were adjusted depending on the experimental purpose while maintaining consistent acoustic features (5 MHz resonant frequency, 0.5 ms PD, and 1 kHz PRF). For the c-Fos assay, each stimulation consisted of six bursts (burst duration (BD) = 0.5 s, interburst interval (IBI) = 1 s) for a total sonication duration (SD) of 9 s, repeated eight times with 60 s inter-sonication intervals (ISIs). For the behavioral phenotype test in the open arena, the same stimulation pattern (BD = 0.5 s, IBI = 1 s, SD = 9 s) was delivered four times with $6 0 \mathrm { ~ s ~ } \mathrm { I S I s }$ . For the real-time place preference (RTPP) test, bilateral stimulation was applied while the animals remained in the stimulation-paired chamber for up to 1 min (BD = 0.5 s, IBI = 1 s), followed by a 30 s timeout before subsequent stimulation could resume. During the cocaine self-administration task, each active lever press triggered stimulation consisting of three bursts (BD = 0.5 s, IBI = 1 s, $\mathrm { S D } = 4 . 5 \mathrm { s } )$
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.isppa_w_cm2: The maximum spatialpeak pulse-average intensity $\mathrm { ( I _ { s p p a } ) }$ at the focal point was determined to be 2.439 W/cm² under both homogeneous and realistic acoustic impedance conditions.

flags.reason: Study comprises separate cohorts: n=8 tFUS mice for the Fos assay and n=10 tFUS mice reused across freezing/RTPP/cocaine behavioral experiments; a 5-mouse off-target subgroup (within the n=10 pooled control) also received real, mistargeted ultrasound and is not counted here; reported as the list of distinct tFUS group sizes.
Session structure differs by sub-experiment (single session for Fos/freezing/RTPP vs. a 4-day extinction phase for the cocaine operant task), so no single per-subject session count is stated.
Not stated as a percentage; PD (0.5 ms) and PRF (1 kHz) are given but duty cycle is not computed by the paper.

Isppa (2.439 W/cm2) was measured in a degassed soybean oil tank during device characterization (pre-implantation), not in the skull/brain; treated as free-field. No in-brain/simulated intensity is reported.
Blinding to group identity is stated only for Fos-positive cell counting, not for the behavioral scoring or overall study design.
Some outcomes were assessed during stimulation (RTPP chamber time, lever pressing) and others well after (Fos, 60 min post-stimulation); coded as both.
